title: NASA to Cover Northrop Grumman CRS-24 Spacecraft Departure
text: After delivering more than 11,000 pounds of supplies, science experiments, and other cargo to the International Space Station for NASA, Northrop Grumman’s Cygnus XL spacecraft is scheduled to depart Friday, Oct. 9, as part of the company’s Commercial Resupply Services-24 mission, or Northrop Grumman CRS-24. Watch NASA’s live coverage of undocking and departure beginning at 12:30 […]

zhTitle: NASA 將報導諾斯洛普·格魯曼 CRS-24 太空船的離發
zh: 在向國際太空站運送超過 11,000 磅的補給品、科學實驗設備及其他貨物給 NASA 之後，諾斯洛普·格魯曼的天鵝座 XL 飛船計劃於週五（10 月 9 日）啟程，作為該公司商業補給服務-24 任務（Commercial Resupply Services-24，簡稱 Northrop Grumman CRS-24）的一部分。觀看 NASA 直播的分離與啟程報導，從 12:30 開始 […]
